authority_and_protocol.acknowledged_effects: Publication, first durable backpressure, prior publication/replay, probe, probe deletion, BOOT, setup and canonical fixture effects retain separate invocation/attempt and fault-scope obligations. A/U do not enter EXT. A prior probe does not establish later recovery. Any required missing recovery assertion stays failed/unproven.
authority_and_protocol.cleanup: Ownership ambiguity/foreign attachment stops affected unsafe deletion, not independently safe remaining cleanup. Exact unresolved obligations prevent acceptance; disposal never supplies a missing atomicity/durability/BOOT result. No repair, substitute Redis, credential regrant or automatic BOOT shortcut.
authority_and_protocol.exception_route: UNAPPROVED/UNAPPLIED teardown-only: individually preapproved fresh exclusive CJ2_COMMIT P1/P2, unmodified same AOF, affirmative K and independently sealed closure, exact source-matched fatal damage refusal, no available ordinary proof, complete safe extinction, honest unavailable-state/BOOT reporting, no rescued state/durability assertion.
authority_and_protocol.online_loading_route: Source permits AUTH/ACL handling during loading, not reliable time to complete all-role proof. Only actually complete proof in the originally approved lifecycle counts; no delayed/repair/substitute server.
authority_and_protocol.prefault_route: Candidate only: durable explicit default-off deny-all first, policy-writer extinction, actual same-server all-role session/reconnect retirement, then stopped-data inventory and one separately approved deliberate edit/startup negative. Owner sequencing interpretation and new helper proof are still required; it cannot retire an authenticated COMMIT in flight.
authority_and_protocol.readiness: ACL/listener/AOF/load/protocol-BOOT states are different. Generic AUTH, WRONGPASS, LOADING, socket access, exit, timeout or OOM prove neither readiness nor exact damage refusal.

d01_confinement.admitted_hypothesis_not_proof: Hardware execution breakpoints plus one fixed hardware single-step/rearm and exact HW debug-regset save/restore are separately reviewed trusted mutations of debug state, not intrinsically read-only tracing. Watchpoints may be post-access; fake-VM success cannot prove Lua Proto/PC correlation.
d01_confinement.authority_limits: No host PID/IPC/user promotion, host mounts/sockets/network/data-write authority, arbitrary target/PID/address/ordinal/expression/path/argv/FD input, software breakpoint, GPR/PC/SP patch, target-memory write, injected hook/syscall, target dumpability/PR_SET_PTRACER change, perf/BPF, root or ambient/filecap fallback.
d01_confinement.bound_interpretation: Proposed rejection ceilings, not demonstrated or authorized feasibility. The pre-instruction witness-to-dispatch bound is not actual target termination or client closure. Keep scheduling delay, all-pause enclosing witnesses, actual stop and client seal distinct; inability to bound clocks/offsets or closure is failure, not threshold relaxation.
d01_confinement.c1: Hypothesis only, not in preparation GO: SYS_PTRACE bit 19 in Eff/Prm/Bnd only and Inh/Amb zero after entrypoint exec; lost/extra sets, need for root/filecap/ambient/inheritable/another exec or denied operation block C1.
d01_confinement.identity: Kernel boot, UID/GID/user namespace inode/maps, PID namespace, exact container ID, process/main-TID/start ticks, executable/mapped instructions and PT_LOAD-derived load bias; invalidate reuse/exec/restart and unexpected tasks. TID filter is not itself a start-time check.
d01_confinement.loss: EXITKILL on SEIZE plus independent controller/watchdog exact-resource cleanup. No assumption of sibling/IPC extinction; observer death, transport/backpressure, missed budget or inspection failure invalidates result. No detach-and-run success on failure.
d01_confinement.preparation_candidate: C0 capless, non-root same UID/GID, exact private target PID namespace; sibling attach may fail without any fallback
d01_confinement.runtime_manifest: Compact separately reviewed closed manifest <=2 MiB required; raw 2,666,992-byte location dump and raw DWARF/disassembly are not executable recipes.
d01_confinement.seccomp: Freeze default-deny OCI profile plus extra-filter template/generator/validator. findings.problem: The frozen base stores all grants in fixture.acl once, deletes users only in live Redis, and authenticates setup in ready(). No reviewed durable ACL helper or postfault read/BOOT role lifecycle exists. Reusing that base sequence for a new restart after measurement retirement would restore forbidden authority. Current cases restart before retirement, so this is not a newly discovered violation in those cases.

proof.description: Independent AST/text checks establish DELUSER/held-disconnect/WRONGPASS with no ACL persistence, no file/dir fsync in initialize, no SAVE/LOAD/SETUSER grant, and setup in ready. Hash-matched Redis source loads ACL before listeners/AOF; an omitted default creates on/nopass/+@all/~*/&*. ACL SAVE does file and directory sync but saves the still-live revoker if called before its deletion. Calling it after deletion cannot assume a surviving admin.

findings.recommendation: For a separately approved corruption-only contract, freeze exactly the explicit deny-all bytes, fixed control-only writer, no-follow/single-link/ownership checks, atomic replacement, successful file+dir sync/readback, writer extinction, then actual all-role live retirement including final revoker/default denial before any fault. All failed prefixes abort the negative while safe cleanup continues. Obtain the owner sequencing interpretation; do not certify this route now. For successful internal-COMMIT restart contracts, durably retire setup while retaining only separately reviewed observation/loading/BOOT roles; never reuse setup-ready or regrant to inspect a failed case.
